meta.homeTitle: Korea Trip Hub — Plan your Korea trip in your language
meta.homeDesc: All-in-one multilingual travel hub for visiting Korea: trip planner, verified essentials (visa, transport), food & hands-on experiences, reviews, and K-culture.

plan.sub: The 6 essentials to sort before you land in Korea.

weather.title: Best Time / Weather
weather.sub: When to visit & what to pack

hero.badge: Trip Planner — the heart of Korea Trip Hub
hero.title_1: Add your hotel. Pick a city.
hero.lede: Tell us where you're staying and where you want to go — say, Busan. We show your transport options (KTX, bus, flight) and draft a day-by-day plan of the city's must-see spots.
hero.f_dest: Where do you want to go?

help.title: Help & Safety
help.sub: Verified essentials to save before you land — every number checked against an official source.
help.check_official: Always confirm at the official source

footer.tagline: The all-in-one hub for visiting Korea — plan, explore, eat and experience, in 10 languages.
footer.disclaimer: Travel facts are checked against official sources with a verification date. Prices, schedules and visa rules change — always confirm at the linked official source before you travel.

map.noResult: No result — try a full address.
map.authFail: Naver Maps couldn't authorize — check the Client ID and registered domain.
map.mapNoteGoogle: Google Maps shows place names in your language — the easiest map to read. For in-Korea directions and transit, switch to Naver or KakaoMap.
map.mapNoteKorean: Naver & KakaoMap have the most detailed Korean road and transit data, but their labels are mostly in Korean. For English and other languages, use Google above.

spotify.title: Listen — K-Pop on Spotify
spotify.sub: Trending groups and the acts fans love worldwide. Pick one to hear their top tracks.
spotify.note: Free previews; full tracks with a Spotify login.
